7.
Every  appointed  or  nominated  member  of  the
Commission shall, unless he vacates office earlier by death,
by operation of law, resignation or removal, hold office for a
term of three years and shall be eligible for reappointment
subject to a maximum period of two successive terms of office.

8.
(1)  Any  appointed  or  nominated  member  of  the
Commission  may  at  any  time  resign  his  office  by  letter
addressed  to  the  Minister  and  such  resignation  shall  take
effect upon it being accepted by the Minister in writing.
